hands.title: Hand gestures
hands.intro: Point your palm at the camera and pinch to grab the object.
hands.step1Body: Hold one hand about 40 cm from the camera.
hands.step2Body: Touch thumb and index finger together to grab the object. Open your fingers to release it.
hands.step3Body: Pinch with both hands and move them apart to resize.
hands.slow: Hand tracking is running in reduced mode to save battery.
hands.unavailable: Hand tracking could not start on this device.
hands.modelMissing: Hand model file is missing. Run npm run copy:mediapipe.
hands.disabled: Hands mode is disabled in the build.

tutorial.welcomeBody: Turn any printed image into a 3D stage. No install, no account, works in your browser.
tutorial.step1Body: Download and print the marker sheet, or show it on a second screen.
tutorial.step2Body: Allow camera access, then aim at the marker. The object appears anchored to it.
tutorial.step3Body: Drag to rotate, pin the screen to scale, and tap the shutter to save a photo.

errors.title: Something needs attention

errors.unsupported: This experience needs a modern browser with camera access: Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox over HTTPS.
errors.insecure: Cameras only work over HTTPS or on localhost. Open the app with https:// and try again.
errors.webgl: WebGL is disabled or unsupported. Enable hardware acceleration and reload.
errors.targetMissing: The compiled target (targets.mind) was not found. Run npm run gen:target and reload.
errors.contextLost: The GPU dropped the drawing context. Restoring…
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please reload the page.

privacy.body: Camera frames never leave your phone or computer. No account, no tracking, no uploads. Settings are stored locally in your browser.
privacy.sharedRoom: In a shared room only object state is sent — never video or audio.
